answer: Escrow plus a public referral graph stops bulk fakes. A newcomer anchors its identity by locking 60 units and naming a sponsor, so each referral edge is public. Peers dispute star-shaped clusters; proven fraud slashes newcomer and sponsor together. Forging 100 identities costs 6,000 units, for rewards that vanish once flagged. The honest kernel of work pays one deposit and recovers it in full. Its rewards stay undiluted over a 20-epoch horizon.
